event_name: Rich Energy Haas F1 Team Document 17 Date 07 June 2019 Time 18:41 2019 CANADIAN GRAND PRIX 6 - 9 June 2019 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, summoned (documents 8 and 9) heard from the drivers and team representatives, have considered the following matter and determine
fact: Collision between Cars 8 and 18 at Turn 13.
offence: Alleged breach of Article 31.4 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence, heard from the driver of car 8 (Romain Grosjean), the driver of car 18 (Lance Stroll) and the team representatives. While it was clear that the left rear wheel of Car 18 touched the right front wheel of Car 8 under braking at the entrance to Turn 13, none of the Drivers were predominantly to blame. The Stewards therefore concluded to take no further action.
rules_referenced: Article 31.4 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Decision Car 8 Incident With Car 18 In Turn 13
